TagDesc.Blade: Swords and knives. Classes that can equip [Blade] can use it; an attack with this tag requires an equipped [Blade].
TagDesc.Katana: Katanas. Classes that can equip [Katana] can use it; an attack with this tag requires an equipped [Katana].
TagDesc.Spear: Spears and polearms. Classes that can equip [Spear] can use it; an attack with this tag requires an equipped [Spear].
TagDesc.Hafted: Axes, maces and hammers. Classes that can equip [Hafted] can use it.
TagDesc.Staff: Staves and wands. Classes that can equip [Staff] can use it. Its Magic Power can't be combined with a [Magic Stone].
TagDesc.Bow: Bows. Classes that can equip [Bow] can use it; an attack with this tag requires an equipped [Bow].
TagDesc.Crossbow: Crossbows. Classes that can equip [Crossbow] can use it.
TagDesc.Throwing: Thrown weapons. Classes that can equip [Throwing] can use it.
TagDesc.Whip: Whips. Classes that can equip [Whip] can use it.
TagDesc.MartialArts: Fist weapons and unarmed techniques. Classes that can equip [Martial Arts] can use it.
TagDesc.MagicStone: Catalyst stones. Its Magic Power can't be combined with a [Staff].
TagDesc.Light: Light weapons. Classes that can equip [Light] can use it (e.g. Sorcerers can use Short Swords, but not other [Blade] items).
TagDesc.LightArmor: Light armor. Classes that can equip [Light Armor] can use it.
TagDesc.MediumArmor: Medium armor. Classes that can equip [Medium Armor] can use it.
TagDesc.HeavyArmor: Heavy armor. Classes that can equip [Heavy Armor] can use it.
TagDesc.Shield: Shields. Classes that can equip [Shield] can use it.
TagDesc.Bag: Adds Inventory Slots. A Bag with [One-Handed] or [Accessory] can also be equipped in those slots.
TagDesc.Head: Worn on the head.
TagDesc.DualWield: Requires a weapon in each hand.
TagDesc.Consumable: The item is lost when used. Unlike other actions, several Consumable items may be used in the same Process or during the Briefing.
TagDesc.Preparation: Can also be used with [Timing: Briefing] before combat without consuming the Briefing action (still only once).
TagDesc.NotForSale: Can't be bought or sold in shops.
TagDesc.Untradeable: Can't be traded to other characters.
TagDesc.Rare: Rare item, usually a prize or crafted.
TagDesc.SummoningWhistle: Whistle that calls a mount or companion.
TagDesc.Training: Conditioning or training. Max 2 Training skills at CR1, 3 at CR11 and 4 at CR21 (Skill Rank doesn't count).
TagDesc.Style: Fighting style. Only one [Style] skill benefits the character at a time; change it as the Setup Process action.
TagDesc.Stance: Only one [Stance] benefits the character at a time; using another ends the previous one.
TagDesc.Harmony: Bard songs. Last until the end of the Scene; by default only one Harmony active at a time, and each target only gains one of the same type.
TagDesc.ServantSummon: Druid/Summoner servants. Last until the end of the Scene; by default only one active at a time.
TagDesc.Enchantment: Enchanter skills. Last until the end of the Scene; by default only TWO active at a time.
TagDesc.Swift: Grants extra actions. At most one [Swift] action during the Briefing and during each Process.
TagDesc.Scout: Gathers information about the next Scene when used during the Briefing (only its starting state).
TagDesc.WeaponAttack: Attack made with the equipped weapon (its tags apply to the damage).
TagDesc.MeleeAttack: Requires a melee weapon; its tags apply to the damage.
TagDesc.RangedAttack: Requires a ranged weapon; its tags apply to the damage.
TagDesc.Human: Any of the Eight Good Races.

Condition.Title: Conditions
Condition.HintSkill: The effects of this skill only apply while every condition is met (e.g. a Style that needs empty hands).
Condition.HintEffect: This effect only applies while every condition is met (e.g. "(SR2): …" tiers). Effects applied on use check them against the user.

RollFilter.Title: Skill filter
RollFilter.Hint: For roll bonuses and skill modifiers (Hate cost, range, note): which skills they apply to. Empty fields don't filter; filled ones must all match.
RollFilter.ExclusiveHint: Only the highest bonus of the same group applies to a roll (e.g. Weapon Mastery).
